name: FILES
summary: Browse, search, tag and edit — including the studio's own source, so the agent can reshape the app you are looking at.

surface.hint: browse, search, tag and edit your media and source — the agent can drive it

/api/focus._note: DECLARED AT LAST, and deliberately optional. This surface has always CALLED focus and never declared it, so the route existed only because canvas, media-manager and mini-nle happen to be co-installed and THEIR declarations built it — a studio with just FILES lost focus silently. Optional is the honest setting: focus is a nicety for a file browser, and an unmatched optional call warns and starts nothing. Marking it required would start the whole video provider on a box that wanted a file browser.

_calls_note: What this app CALLS — a different fact from what a provider ANSWERS. It was `verbs`, a flat list doing double duty: authored by the app to mean a dependency, consumed by the composer as provider routing. That double duty is how a route could exist only because some unrelated app declared it.

provider._note: A REFERENCE, not a run spec. How to start this backend, and the live-state companion that used to sit here, are declared by the provider itself in providers/studio-host/provider.json — the provider is authoritative about itself and an app has no standing to say otherwise. The companion moved because keeping it here pinned a bug rather than removing it: it arrived here only after being lost with the AGENTS app, and retiring FILES the same way would have lost it again.
